kind: must-be-deep
depth: deep
reason: deep-policy
-- base/main.tf --
module "child" {
  source = "./modules/child"
}

resource "aws_sqs_queue" "this" {
  name   = "q"
  policy = jsonencode({ Statement = [{ Action = module.child.actions }] })
}
-- base/modules/child/main.tf --
output "actions" {
  value = ["sqs:SendMessage"]
}
-- head/main.tf --
module "child" {
  source = "./modules/child"
}

resource "aws_sqs_queue" "this" {
  name   = "q"
  policy = jsonencode({ Statement = [{ Action = module.child.actions }] })
}
-- head/modules/child/main.tf --
output "actions" {
  value = ["sqs:SendMessage", "sqs:ReceiveMessage"]
}
